name: Heth
overview: The Bible identifies Heth as a son of Canaan and the ancestor of the Hittites, establishing a genealogical link important for understanding the peoples surrounding Israel (Genesis 10:15). The descendants of Heth, often referred to as the children of Heth, appear in significant interactions with Abraham, notably in the negotiation and purchase of a burial site, demonstrating their established presence and role in the land (Genesis 23:3, 5, 7, 10, 16). These passages highlight the historical and relational context of the Hittites within the biblical narrative, emphasizing God's providence in Abraham’s dealings with them.
